site_url.description: The website to audit, e.g. https://www.example.com. A bare host gets https://.

max_pages.description: How many pages to audit, homepage included. Default 15.

pages.description: URLs on the same site to audit first, e.g. the pages a Search Console step found opportunities on.

focus_keywords.description: Up to 10 phrases the site should rank for, one per line or comma-separated. Each is checked against every audited page's title and H1.
